1. **[blocker] D2 / D3 / S0-3** — `astro.config.mjs` cannot use `hyperdrive()` for Workers runtime and `postgres()` for build-time prerendering in one build, and D2's SSR fallback exceeds Workers Free CPU/RAM limits — During `astro build` in GitHub Actions, Astro compiles the Worker bundle and executes `export const prerender = true` pages in the same pass from one `astro.config.mjs`: keeping `database: hyperdrive({ binding: "HYPERDRIVE" })` breaks build-time `getEmDashCollection()` in Node (no live Hyperdrive binding), while conditionally swapping to `postgres({ connectionString })` bakes the Node driver instead of `hyperdrive()` into the Worker. Falling back to D2's SSR + `cacheCloudflare()` executes D5's Markdown pipeline (KaTeX + Shiki with all `bundledLanguages` + `shiki-plantuml`) on cache misses inside Workers Free's 10 ms CPU / 128 MB RAM caps (and `cacheCloudflare()` does not cache on `*.workers.dev`) — In `S0-3`, either query Postgres from prerendered pages via a dedicated build-only `DATABASE_URL` helper (leaving `hyperdrive()` strictly for `/_emdash/*` SSR) or verify build-time `CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_HYPERDRIVE` injection while confirming the emitted Worker still binds `HYPERDRIVE`; drop the SSR + `cacheCloudflare()` fallback for Markdown posts on Free in favor of pre-rendered HTML on publish or static-only + local admin.

2. **[blocker] D10 / PORT-8 / CUT-2 / D9** — Generated data artifacts live inside the deleted `src/content` submodule, and no CI pipeline produces them for posts published via EmDash — [config.js](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/consts/config.js) places `metadata/*.json`, `.umap-state.json`, `podcast.json`, `gallery.json`, and `gallery/*.svg` under `src/content/generated/`. `CUT-2` deletes `src/` and the `src/content` submodule with no story relocating those files, breaking [rss.xml.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/src/pages/rss.xml.ts), search (`getAllClientPostsForSearch` in [post.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/utils/post.ts)), cover colors, UMAP, and `/api/gallery/trace/[file].svg`. Separately, [collect-metadata.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/content-prepare/src/collect-metadata.ts#L147-L154) requires a local LM Studio / Python embedding server and Rust UMAP binary, so when D9's publish webhook triggers a GitHub Actions build, newly published posts have no metadata JSON and silently disappear from RSS, search, world map locations, cover colorization, and related posts — Compute RSS items, search index, excerpts, and `isShort` directly from EmDash during `astro build`; add a pre-`CUT-2` story relocating persistent artifacts (embeddings, `.umap-state.json`, cover colors, geocoded coordinates, gallery trace SVGs) out of `src/content/generated/` into a tracked repo directory or Postgres columns; define graceful CI fallbacks for new posts awaiting offline embeddings/UMAP.

3. **[blocker] D3 / INF-2 / INF-4 / §10** — Supabase Free direct Postgres connections are IPv6-only and fail on GitHub Actions without a paid add-on — D3 permits Supabase's "direct or session" connection string for CLI, migrations, and builds. On Supabase Free, direct hosts (`db.<ref>.supabase.co:5432`) publish only IPv6 AAAA records (IPv4 direct requires Supabase's paid IPv4 add-on, violating §9 #3 / [AGENT_RULES.md](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/docs/plan/emdash/AGENT_RULES.md)). GitHub Actions `ubuntu-latest` runners are IPv4-only and fail with `Network is unreachable` during `INF-4` builds/migrations and `INF-6` keep-alives; pointing Hyperdrive (`INF-3`) at an IPv6 direct host or Supavisor Transaction Pooler (`6543`) without disabling prepared statements also breaks TLS/IPv6 or Kysely prepared statements — Remove "direct" from D3/INF-2/INF-4; standardize all CI, CLI, and keep-alive connections on Supabase's IPv4-compatible Supavisor Session Pooler (`aws-0-<region>.pooler.supabase.com:5432`), and explicitly test Hyperdrive's upstream pooler mode + TLS config in `S0-2`/`INF-3`.

4. **[blocker] CMS-3 / CUT-1 / §8** — WebAuthn passkeys registered on `next.growgen.xyz` lock the owner out of `/_emdash/admin` upon cutover to `growgen.xyz`, and required EmDash secrets are missing — `CMS-3` enrolls passkeys on `next.growgen.xyz`, which binds WebAuthn credentials to that origin/`rpId` (`EMDASH_SITE_URL`). When `CUT-1` cuts DNS and `EMDASH_SITE_URL` over to `growgen.xyz`, those passkeys stop authenticating with no documented re-enrollment/recovery procedure. Additionally, `EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `EMDASH_SITE_URL` are omitted from §8 and `INF-2`/`INF-3` (losing `EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY` corrupts access to encrypted plugin/webhook configs), and deploying `/_emdash/admin` to `*.workers.dev` in `S0-2`/`INF-3` before passkey setup leaves the first-admin setup wizard open to anyone — Add `EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `EMDASH_SITE_URL` to §8 and `INF-3`; lock `/_emdash/admin` immediately on first deploy (passkey enrollment or Cloudflare Access Free); add an explicit passkey transition step to `CUT-1` (keep `next.growgen.xyz` reachable or run EmDash's domain-change/passkey-enrollment flow on `growgen.xyz` before retiring `next.growgen.xyz`, and update `astro.config.mjs` `site`, sitemap, RSS, and canonicals).

5. **[blocker] D5 / D1 / S0-4 / PORT-2** — Astro's `markdown` config and `astro-mermaid` do not process Markdown strings loaded from Postgres, and `shiki-plantuml` is an untracked git submodule — [astro.config.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/astro.config.mjs#L39-L64)'s `markdown.processor` and `astro-mermaid` only transform `.md`/`.mdx` files loaded via Astro Content Collections, not database text fields. [BlogPost.astro](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/layouts/BlogPost.astro#L37) and [extract.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/utils/extract.ts#L22) also require `render(entry)`'s `headings` output for TOCs and H1 title extraction; `@emdash-cms/plugin-field-kit` provides JSON form controls rather than a Markdown field widget; and [.gitmodules](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/.gitmodules#L5-L7) shows `packages/shiki-plantuml` is a separate git submodule omitted from `INF-4` and threatened by `CUT-2` — In `S0-4`/`PORT-2`, use `@astrojs/markdown-remark`'s `createMarkdownProcessor()` (already in [package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/package.json#L42)) with the existing remark/rehype plugins and `shikiConfig` to obtain both HTML (`code`) and `metadata.headings`, plus a remark/rehype Mermaid block transform with client Mermaid hydration instead of `astro-mermaid`; retain `packages/shiki-plantuml` in CI checkouts and exclude it from `CUT-2` deletion.

6. **[major] D6 / S0-5 / §10** — Fallback #3 (`s3()` to R2) requires a paid-billing payment method, and Option #2 forces Cloudinary into EmDash's raw-byte `Storage` interface — Cloudflare R2 requires a credit card on file and automatically bills overages (no hard free cap), violating §9 #3 and [AGENT_RULES.md](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/docs/plan/emdash/AGENT_RULES.md); pairing R2 with Cloudinary auto-upload also duplicates storage and leaves EmDash storing R2 keys rather than `f_auto,q_auto` Cloudinary URLs. Meanwhile, EmDash's `Storage` interface expects a raw byte store (`put`/`get`/`delete`/`list`, byte ranges, defaulting to `/_emdash/api/media/file/` Worker proxying), which mismatches Cloudinary's versioned `public_id`s and split `image`/`video`/`raw` resource types — In `S0-5`, implement EmDash's **external Media Provider** abstraction (built for transformation CDNs like Cloudflare Images) instead of raw `Storage`; replace Fallback #3 with EmDash's built-in `s3()` adapter pointed at **Supabase Storage Free** (1 GB, S3-compatible, hard-capped, no credit card) + Cloudinary auto-upload mapping.

7. **[major] MIG-0 / D8 / CMS-1 / PORT-5 / F1–F8** — URL-preservation and schema gaps miss PDFs, SVGs, NDJSON, unlisted routes, draft posts, date timezone shifts, slug collisions, and static 404/trailing-slash config — `MIG-0` captures only "HTML/JSON/XML + sitemap", omitting 18 resume PDFs (`/resume/pdfs/*.pdf` written by [generate-pdfs.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/resume/generate-pdfs.mjs#L28-L30), which hardcodes `dist/` instead of `@astrojs/cloudflare`'s `apps/web/dist/client/`), `/api/gallery/trace/[file].svg`, `.ndjson` endpoints, `/resume` ([resume.astro](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/src/pages/resume.astro)), `/cv` ([cv.astro](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/src/pages/cv.astro)), and `/hero/*` ([astro.config.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/astro.config.mjs#L31-L36)). Legacy [[slug].astro](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/src/pages/[category]/[year]/[month]/[day]/[slug].astro#L8-L10) builds `type: "draft"` files from [content.config.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/src/content.config.ts) without filtering, whereas EmDash hides `draft` entries; [extract.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/utils/extract.ts#L37-L39) builds dates in local timezone (so UTC `published_at` in Postgres can shift URLs by ±1 day); duplicate filenames across dates collide with EmDash's unique `slug` (`409 SLUG_CONFLICT`); EmDash auto-slugifying `tag`/`series`/`city` breaks `/tag/<lowercase>`, `/series/<slug>`, and `/world/<citySlug>` ([city.ts](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/utils/city.ts)); and unconfigured Workers Static Assets `not_found_handling` sends 404 bot traffic into the SSR Worker, burning the 100k/day quota — Snapshot every non-`_astro` file in legacy `dist/` (including `.pdf`, `.svg`, `.ndjson`); store immutable `legacy_id` (`YYYY/MM/DD/slug`, also required by `PV_URL` and gallery `doc` links), timezone-free post dates, and exact legacy taxonomy slugs in `CMS-1`; audit `type: "draft"` files before `MIG-0`; update [generate-pdfs.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/packages/resume/generate-pdfs.mjs) for `apps/web/dist/client/`; configure `assets.html_handling` and `not_found_handling: "404-page"` in `INF-3`.

8. **[major] MIG-2** — `cld migrate` fails on Douban anti-hotlink checks and mixed-domain URL lists — `cld migrate <UPLOAD_MAPPING> <FILE>` requires all URLs in `<FILE>` to share one upload-mapping prefix and relies on Cloudinary's servers fetching the origin without custom headers. Douban (`img*.doubanio.com`) rejects server-side/missing-`Referer` fetches with `403 Forbidden`, arbitrary external hosts require creating/deleting one mapping per domain, and `cld migrate` produces no old-URL → new-URL mapping file for Markdown rewriting — Replace `cld migrate` with a script that downloads external images locally with browser `User-Agent`/`Referer` headers (recording dead links), uploads local bytes via `cld uploader upload` (or Upload API) under deterministic `public_id`s, and writes a JSON rewrite map applied before `MIG-1`.

9. **[major] S0-2 / INF-6 / §7 / §10 / AGENT_RULES.md #2** — The 3 MB compressed Worker gate targets an obsolete Cloudflare limit while the actual Free-tier killer (10 ms CPU) is unmeasured — Cloudflare removed compressed script size limits (formerly 3 MiB Free) and now enforces **64 MiB uncompressed** (`Total Upload`) across Free and Paid plans. `INF-6`'s CI check ("fail above 3 MB") will falsely fail valid EmDash + Postgres Workers and can trigger an unnecessary fallback to local-only admin in `S0-2`, while no story verifies whether `/_emdash/admin` SSR, Passkey crypto, Postgres TLS handshakes, or export endpoints fit inside Workers Free's **10 ms CPU** cap (`Error 1102`) — Update `S0-2`, `INF-6`, §10, and [AGENT_RULES.md](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/docs/plan/emdash/AGENT_RULES.md) to enforce 64 MiB uncompressed (`wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir`) plus the 20,000 static-asset file limit, and add a real-request CPU-ms verification in `S0-2` and `QA-2` via `wrangler tail` / Workers analytics.

10. **[major] §5 / §6 (Sprints 0–2 & 6)** — Critical dependency inversions and a broken 7-day rollback window — (a) `S0-2` (Nov 30) deploys a Hyperdrive + Supabase "hello post" to `*.workers.dev` before `INF-1` (local Supabase), `INF-2` (cloud Supabase), and `INF-3` (Hyperdrive) exist (Dec 7–11); (b) `S0-4` (Dec 1) starts before `S0-2` finishes scaffolding `apps/web` (Dec 2) and before `S0-8` plan review updates land (Dec 1); (c) `CMS-3` (passkeys on `testing` & `production`, Dec 10) and `INF-6` (CI guards, Dec 11) run before `INF-3` finishes `next.growgen.xyz` (Dec 11) and before `INF-4` deploys via CI (Dec 14); (d) `CUT-2` deletes `src/` and `vercel.json` on Feb 11—1 day after `CUT-1`—triggering Vercel auto-deploy on `master` and destroying the "Vercel kept warm for 7 days" rollback; (e) `SOAK-1` allows 2 weeks of authoring in EmDash, then `CUT-1` runs `MIG-5` (`--on-conflict update` from legacy), overwriting any edits made to migrated posts during soak (conflicting with §7's freeze rule) — Provision minimal Supabase/Hyperdrive inside `S0-2` (or scope `S0-2` to local Docker + dry-run); sequence `S0-4`/`S0-5` after `S0-2` and `S0-8`; move `CMS-3` and `INF-6` after `INF-3`/`INF-4`; freeze legacy and run `MIG-5` *before* `SOAK-1` starts; schedule `CUT-2` ≥7 days after `CUT-1` (Feb 18+).

11. **[major] §5 / §6 (Sprints 2–5)** — `QA-1` breaks CI for 4 weeks, `MIG-1`/`MIG-2` order causes double rewrites, and single agents are double-booked — `QA-1` enables full `legacy-urls.txt` CI parity on Dec 21 (day 1 of Sprint 3) while §4 DoD requires it green on every story, guaranteeing CI failures across Sprints 3–4 until `PORT-5` and `PORT-7` finish on Jan 15. `MIG-1` (Dec 14–16) imports 994 posts *before* `MIG-2` rehosts images (Dec 17–18) and while `CMS-2` is unfinished, forcing a second pass over all 994 posts; `MIG-4` (Jan 19–20) overlaps `PORT-8` (Jan 18–20), diffing HTML before metadata/relates exist; single agents are double-booked (`PORT-4` + `PORT-6` for Builder-Core on Jan 11; `INF-3` + `CMS-3`/`INF-6` for Builder-Infra Dec 10–11; `MIG-1` + `MIG-3` for Migrator Dec 16); `QA-3` sits on launch day (Jan 22) with no fix buffer; and Sprint 3's Gantt omits winter holidays — Scope `QA-1` per ported route group until Sprint 4 ends; order `CMS-2` → `MIG-2` → `MIG-1` and `PORT-8` → `MIG-4`; serialize single-agent lanes (or split Builder-Core) and add a fix buffer before launch.

12. **[major] D4 / INF-5** — `emdash export-seed` does not work on Postgres, remote Worker `site export` risks Free-tier limits, and `INF-5` is scheduled after feature porting ends — `emdash export-seed` reads only local SQLite files (`./data.db`), not Supabase Postgres (D3). Running `site export` through the `testing` Worker HTTP endpoint for 994 posts + taxonomies risks Workers Free's 10 ms CPU / 128 MB RAM limits. Moreover, `INF-5` is scheduled in Sprint 5 (Jan 18), leaving `PORT-1..7` (Sprints 3–4) without local synced test data — Remove `export-seed` from D4; replace `site export/import` glue in `INF-5` with existing Supabase CLI / Postgres `pg_dump --data-only` + `psql` (excluding auth/passkey tables) over the Session Pooler, and move `INF-5` into Sprint 2 right after `MIG-1`.

13. **[major] Missing stories (§4 / §5 / CUT-2)** — No Postgres backup/DR, no `noindex` guard during the 2-week soak, and untracked legacy components (`pv-counter`, `PUBLIC_BUILD_SHA`, analytics-on e2e, hydration check) — Supabase Free has zero automated backups and §10 excludes PITR, so after `CUT-2` archives the content repo a bad migration permanently loses 994 posts. Running all 994 posts live on `next.growgen.xyz` for 2 weeks (and `*.workers.dev` permanently) without `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` / `robots.txt` disallow creates duplicate-content SEO indexing against `growgen.xyz`. Finally, `packages/pv-counter` (serving `PV_URL`), `PUBLIC_BUILD_SHA` ([astro.config.mjs](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/astro.config.mjs#L69-L71) reads `VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`), `scripts/hydration-check.mjs`, `oxlint`/`oxfmt`, and the dual-build `test:e2e:analytics-on` check ([package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/package.json#L16)) have no stories and risk deletion in `CUT-2` or silent breakage — Add nightly `pg_dump` backups in GitHub Actions to `INF-6`; add `noindex`/`robots.txt` gating for `testing` and `next.growgen.xyz` in `INF-3`/`PORT-7` (flipped in `CUT-1`); explicitly retain `packages/pv-counter` (checking CORS for `next.growgen.xyz`), wire `PUBLIC_BUILD_SHA` to `GITHUB_SHA` in `INF-4`, and include `test:e2e:analytics-on` + `check:hydration` in `PORT-9`.

14. **[major] MIG-1 / MIG-5 / MIG-4 / INF-6** — Custom scripts and redundant workflows are planned where existing tools already solve the problem — Splitting `MIG-1` (custom CLI/API loop importing 994 posts) and `MIG-5` (idempotent re-import) reinvents EmDash's built-in `npx emdash seed <file> --on-conflict update`, which already upserts collections, taxonomies, and entries on Postgres in one pass. `MIG-4` feeds 994 HTML diffs to `gemini-3.8-flash-medium` where deterministic HTML/DOM normalization diffing (e.g. `html-differ` / Playwright DOM & link/heading assertions) gives exact coverage without LLM omissions. `INF-6`'s daily keep-alive duplicates D9's nightly rebuild on `production` (which already queries production Postgres every 24h) — Generate a single EmDash seed JSON and merge `MIG-1` + `MIG-5` into `npx emdash seed --on-conflict update`; use deterministic structural HTML diffing in `MIG-4` (reserving Gemini for triaging flagged anomalies); restrict `INF-6`'s keep-alive to `testing` (or fold both pings into the nightly workflow).

15. **[minor] S0-1 / §4 / §6 / D1** — Stale Gantt status, root workspace config mismatch, and unvalidated dependency-stack compatibility between root and `apps/web` — [emdash-migration-plan.md](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/docs/plan/emdash-migration-plan.md#L264) marks `S0-1` `:done` despite §0/§9 stating Sprint 0 has not started, and [pnpm-workspace.yaml](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/pnpm-workspace.yaml) already contains `apps/*` while root [package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/package.json#L6-L8) still lists only `"workspaces": ["packages/*"]`. Root [package.json](file:///Volumes/MacData/github/blog.gongbushang.com/package.json#L141-L145) also pins Astro `7.3.3`, React `19.2.6`, Mantine `9`, Tailwind `3.4`, TypeScript `6`, and a `pnpm.overrides` entry for `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat`, whereas `npm create emdash@latest` brings its own Astro/React/Tailwind peer versions with no verification step before `PORT-1` — Reset `S0-1` status in §6, align `package.json` `workspaces` with `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and add a peer/hoisting compatibility check in `S0-2` validating EmDash's Astro/React/Tailwind versions against Mantine 9, MUI 7, and `@react-three/rapier`.
